title: MUST DO FOOD TOUR
text: We LOVED Colin! He was super friendly and knowledgable and the places we went really were away from touristy areas. This is a must do.
author: S3854TMgabrielef

title: Great tour, great guide, great food.
text: Great tapas crawl with the genial Colin, mainly Americans, us Brits and a chap from Ireland. 4 stops, plenty of delicious food and drink, plus an extra tasty fish street food snack. Most food is delivered on shared platters, but everyone was polite and only took their fair share. Colin kept up with interesting tales about the food and places we stopped at, a fair amount of walking across town, but leisurely paced. Our first foodie tour, and it won't be the last.
author: 37Rycroft

title: Excellent food/drink/Jeff/group. Great evening
text: We were lucky to have a lovely friendly group and the excellent guide Jeff. Jeff was super enthusiastic sharing some history mixed in with a lot of food facts-Jeff is passionate about food and this tour. We went to four different tapas bars having different food choices and drink suggestions at each. Evening lasted over 3 hours plus we went for  cocktail afterwards with friends made on the tour. Save to say food and drink delicious. Our group of 10 ( 5 Brits , 2 US and 3 Netherlands) all made the effort to chat and enjoy each other’s company and this really made the evening special. title: Great food and company

title: Perfect First Night in Seville
text:
We had a fantastic time on our tapas crawl with Colin! It was the perfect way to kick off the first night of our trip and get a taste of what Seville has to offer.

Colin was a brilliant host – friendly, knowledgeable and great fun. We loved visiting different places, trying a variety of delicious local food and drinks, and learning a bit more about the local food scene.

Would highly recommend this experience to anyone visiting Seville. Thank you, Colin, for making our first night so memorable! 😊
author: kayleighc152
